Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 is now out on 25th July 2026 on the official website of Union Bank of India. The result is out in PDF format with the registration numbers of the shortlisted candidates. Candidates who have appeared for the online exam on 7th June 2026 can now check their qualification status. This recruitment is being conducted to fill 1865 Apprentice vacancies for various states in India. You can download the Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 PDF through the direct link given below in this article.

Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Out

The Union Bank Apprentice online examination was conducted on 7th June 2026. The result PDF contains the registration numbers of candidates provisionally selected for apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The selected candidates will be sent a separate email on their registered email ID with the details of reporting venue and date for pre-engagement formalities. The provisional selection is subject to successful document verification, language proficiency test (if applicable) and submission of required medical fitness certificate. The candidates are advised to keep checking the registered email and the official website for further updates on the joining process.

Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 Download Link

Candidates can download the result PDF from the direct link given below and search for their registration number to check their selection status. The PDF includes the registration numbers of candidates who have been provisionally shortlisted for apprenticeship. Candidates should also keep checking their registered email ID for further instructions regarding document verification and other pre-engagement formalities.

Direct Link to Download Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 PDF

How to Check Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026?

You can check the Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 online easily through the official site of Union Bank of India. Follow the simple steps below to download the result PDF and check the qualifying status.

  1. Visit the official website of the Union Bank of India.
  2. Head to the Career or Recruitment section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link for Engagement of 1865 Apprentices – Result 2026.
  4. The Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 PDF will open on the screen.
  5. Check your result by entering Your Registration Number in the Ctrl+F Box.
  6. Download and save the result PDF for future reference.

What After Union Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026?

Candidates who are provisionally selected in the Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 will receive a detailed reporting schedule on their registered email ID. They must complete document verification and also submit the required certificates.

Details
10 recent photographs (same as uploaded on the NATS Portal)
Aadhaar Card and PAN Card/PAN allotment proof
Permanent and Communication Address Proof
Original Class 10, Class 12, Degree certificates, and all mark sheets
SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwBD certificates, if applicable
One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents
Printed copy of the NATS Portal profile
Subject to successful completion of document verification, language test (if applicable), and medical fitness verification

UBI Apprentice Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the Union Bank Apprentice Result 2026 released?

Ans: Yes, the Union Bank Apprentice Result is released on 25th July 2026.

Q2. How can I download the UBI Apprentice Result 2026 PDF?

Ans: You can download the PDF from the official website of Union Bank of India and then type Ctrl + F to search for your registration number.

Q3. What is mentioned in the Union Bank Apprentice Merit List 2026?

Ans: The Union Bank Apprentice Merit List includes all the registration numbers of candidates.

Q4. What happens after the Union Bank of India Apprentice Result 2026?

Ans: The candidates who are provisionally selected are required to attend document verification and language proficiency test (if applicable).

Q5. When was the Union Bank Apprentice Exam 2026 conducted?

Ans: The Union Bank Apprentice Exam 2026 was conducted on 7th June 2026.
